note: Campground at Cuyuna Country SRA near Crosby and Ironton, above Portsmouth Mine Lake (a flooded iron-ore pit) with a swimming beach below the loops; shaded and open grassy sites. The recreation area's 50+ miles of mountain-bike singletrack start nearby. --Claude
summary: DNR record + campground map + ReserveMN read: 18 electric (17 online, 50/30-amp) + 11 non-electric drive-in back-ins (30-70 ft) + 4 walk-ins; $24 / $34 electric confirmed; no water/sewer/dump/fill; shower building closed in 2026; season 2027 Apr 30-Oct 24 (2026 to Oct 31). Not waterfront kept; pin OK.
flags: Mountain-bike trail area, not OHV (per the brief): no flag.

Facilities: 'Portsmouth Campground Shower Building is closed for the 2026 camping season' (DNR seasonal update) - recorded in facilities.note; showers/flush_toilets kept true as the park's normal facilities. Reviewer may prefer to drop the 2026 wording once 2027 opens.
Booking: platform operator (derived) -> usedirect, the state:MN row's value; url = the ReserveMN park link already in website.

Sites: stored 33 (note prose: 18 + 15) kept; that 15 non-electric includes the 4 walk-in tent sites, so drive-in sites are 18 electric + 11 non-electric = 29 (DNR: '29 sites'). The 4 walk-ins are 30-33 near the parking lot. Every drive-in site takes a 23-ft rig (30 ft and up). Note DNR's own text is inconsistent ('29 sites - 18 electric, 15 non-electric').

Waterfront: keep not waterfront. The loops sit ~150-300 m NW of Portsmouth Mine Lake in woods; the campground map puts the swimming beach at the end of a road south of sites 5-6, which are the nearest and still well back from the shore.

Pin 46.49150,-93.97290 is ~25 m from ReserveMN's facility point (46.49171,-93.97277) on the campground loops: OK. (DNR's text GPS for 'Portsmouth Campground' repeats the Miner's Mountain Rally Center coordinates and is not the campground.)

Website lines both confirmed (DNR park page, ReserveMN park 81).
